message: So there I was, cooking dinner and feeling pretty proud of my multitasking skills. I had my phone propped up, following a recipe video, when suddenly it died—right as I was supposed to check on my simmering sauce. Thankfully, I knew the basics, but it reminded me how important it is to have a plan B in place, like a printed recipe or a fire escape route. You never know when tech will let you down! What’s your go-to backup plan?
